stem: A room's pesticide restricted-entry interval has expired, but the plants remain under a facility biosecurity quarantine and a quality hold. What is the strongest interpretation of the room's status?
choices: All restrictions end when the restricted-entry interval expires
The quarantine and hold remain in force until their separate authorized release processes are completed
The technician may enter and move material because only pesticide restrictions have legal force
The quarantine can be ignored if the plants show no visible symptoms
rationale: Different controls can coexist and arise from different decision systems. Expiration of a pesticide restricted-entry interval removes that specific restriction but does not automatically clear a biosecurity quarantine or quality hold.
